title: Best 8 Loopio Alternatives & Competitors in 2026 (Compared & Reviewed)
summary: Looking for the best Loopio alternatives? Compare 8 leading RFP tools by AI, pricing, integrations, reviews, and response quality in 2026.
body_markdown:
*Last reviewed: July 2026. This comparison is based on vendor-published materials, verified G2 and Capterra reviews, and independent third-party analyses. Pricing and feature details change over time, so confirm current specifics directly with each vendor before purchasing.*


**TL;DR**


If Loopio's content library has become difficult to maintain or you're looking for more advanced AI capabilities, there are several alternatives worth considering.


- **Inventive AI:** Best for AI-first RFP automation.
- **Responsive:** Best for enterprise proposal management.
- **Arphie:** Best for security questionnaires and DDQs.
- **Ombud:** Best for collaboration and content governance.
- **QorusDocs:** Best for Microsoft 365 users.
- **RocketDocs:** Best for regulated industries.
- **Qvidian:** Best for enterprise content management.
- **AutoRFP.ai:** Best for project-based pricing with unlimited users.


*Magic doesn't work as well as I hoped. It is not the most accurate and requires a lot of manual work."* —[G2 reviewer](https://www.g2.com/products/loopio/reviews/loopio-review-11974149)


That sentiment isn't isolated. While users like Loopio for its easy-to-use interface, collaboration tools, and centralized content library, many also say responses need manual editing, search results aren't always accurate, and keeping the content library up to date requires ongoing effort.


As[AI-powered RFP software](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/why-ai-native-rfp-software-is-replacing-legacy-tools-like-responsive-and-loopio) has improved, many teams are looking for tools that can[generate more accurate responses](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/scale-your-rfp-rfi-response-with-automation-and-ai) , tailor answers, and reduce manual work.


To help you choose, we compared the 8 best Loopio alternatives based on AI capabilities, response quality, pricing, integrations, and verified customer reviews.


## Why Should You Consider an Alternative to Loopio Software?


- [AI responses need review](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/blog-posts-ai-in-the-rfp-process-2025) **:** Users report that AI-generated answers can be inaccurate or overly generic, requiring manual edits before submission.
- **Limited document handling:** Complex Excel questionnaires, Word mapping, and formatting often require additional manual work.
- **Search results can be inconsistent:** Finding the most relevant approved content can take extra effort when search returns loosely related answers.
- **Library maintenance takes time:** Keeping the[content library](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/winning-rfp-content-library) accurate and up to date requires ongoing effort from proposal teams.
- **Advanced customization is limited:** Workflow, reporting, and template customization may not meet the needs of every enterprise.
- **Steeper learning curve for advanced features:** While the basics are easy to use, more advanced capabilities can take time to learn and configure.

## 1. Inventive AI (best for teams looking for an AI-first alternative to traditional RFP software)


AI-native proposal platforms that take a different architectural approach. Inventive AI is one example.


[Inventive AI](https://www.inventive.ai/) is an agentic AI and autonomous platform built specifically for RFP, RFI, and security questionnaire responses, keeping humans in loop for approval, aimed at sales, solution engineering, and presales teams.


Teams looking for an AI-native alternative to legacy Q&A library-based platforms, particularly where reducing manual drafting time, with better quality responses and centralizing scattered documentation are top priorities.


### Inventive AI best features


- **AI-generated first drafts:** Creates context-aware responses from connected knowledge sources instead of matching answers from a static library.
- **Unified knowledge hub:** Connects[Google Drive](https://www.inventive.ai/integrations/google-drive-rfp-automation) ,[SharePoint](https://www.inventive.ai/integrations/sharepoint-rfp-automation) ,[Confluence,](https://www.inventive.ai/integrations/confluence-rfp-automation)[Notion](https://www.inventive.ai/integrations/notion-rfp-automation) ,[Salesforce](https://www.inventive.ai/integrations/salesforce-rfp-automation) , and past proposals into a single searchable[knowledge base](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/top-best-rfp-knowledge-management-software-tools) .
- **Conflict detection:** Flags outdated, duplicate, or contradictory content before it appears in customer responses.
- **Deal-specific personalization:** Tailors responses to each RFP instead of reusing the same library content across every opportunity.
- **Competitive intelligence agents:** Research competitors and generate win themes as part of the proposal workflow.
- **Supports multiple formats:** Works with Excel questionnaires, Word documents, PDFs, and narrative proposals.
- **Collaborative reviews:** Built-in review workflows with assignments, bulk actions, and approvals.


### Inventive limitations


- Reporting and analytics could offer deeper dashboards and more customizable insights
- No native Jira integration is currently available.
- Some users report search, notifications, and mobile experience could be improved


### Inventive pricing


- Pricing is based on the number of RFPs and[security questionnaires](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/how-to-answer-a-security-questionnaire) your team handles, with **unlimited users** included and no per-seat licensing.
- A fixed platform fee covers setup, onboarding, and all features.

## 2. Responsive (Best for enterprise-scale proposal and questionnaire management)


[Responsive](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/responsive-ai-rfpio-pricing-features-reviews) , formerly RFPIO, positions itself as an AI-first strategic response management platform built for RFPs, InfoSec questionnaires, government bids, DDQs, and sales proposals at enterprise scale.


via Responsive


### Responsive best features


- AI Assistant and AI agents generate first drafts with source citations.
- Automatically answers security questionnaires and vendor risk assessments.
- Offers around 30 native integrations along with 75+ APIs for connecting business systems.
- Supports 23+ languages with linked content versions for global teams.
- Project-based collaboration allows occasional contributors without requiring licenses for every user.


### Responsive limitations


- AI is built on a traditional Q&A library rather than a live knowledge model.
- Does not identify conflicting or inconsistent content across the knowledge base.
- Lacks built-in competitive intelligence or win-theme recommendations.
- Responses primarily rely on shared content libraries instead of tailoring answers to each buyer or opportunity.
- Users report that AI may generate content outside approved sources, requiring additional review in regulated industries.


### Responsive pricing


- Starts at **$5,000/year for 5 users (Lite plan)** , with higher tiers for growing and enterprise teams.
- Mid and enterprise plans are **custom-priced** based on users, features, and deployment needs.
- Overall pricing is **quote-based with per-user licensing and add-ons** , so costs vary by scale.


### Responsive ratings and reviews

## 3. Arphie (Best for security questionnaire automation)


[Arphie](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/arphie-pricing-features-reviews) is an AI-native response management platform built for RFPs, security questionnaires, and due diligence questionnaires (DDQs). Instead of relying on a traditional content library, it connects to your existing knowledge sources to generate context-aware responses. The platform is designed for sales engineering, proposal, and security teams looking to automate repetitive questionnaires while maintaining answer accuracy.


### Arphie best features


- Connects to live knowledge sources like Google Drive, SharePoint, Confluence, Notion, Seismic, and Highspot to generate responses using up-to-date information.
- Generates intent-based AI drafts with confidence scores, source links, and reasoning to help reviewers verify responses.
- Automatically identifies and merges duplicate Q&A entries to keep knowledge organized with less manual effort.
- Includes enterprise-grade security features such as SOC 2 Type II compliance, SSO support, encryption at rest and in transit, and role-based access controls.


### Arphie limitations


- Some import, export, and formatting workflows still need improvement, according to user reviews.
- Reporting and analytics capabilities are less mature than those of established enterprise platforms.
- Does not include built-in competitive intelligence features
- Primarily focused on structured questionnaires and does not support narrative-style proposals as comprehensively as some alternatives.


### Arphie pricing


- Arphie does not publish pricing publicly.

## 4. Ombud (Best for enterprise proposal and presales collaboration)


[Ombud](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/ombud-pricing-features-reviews) is a response management platform that helps teams manage RFPs, security questionnaires, proposals, and statements of work from a single workspace. Along with AI-assisted response generation, it focuses on content governance, collaboration, and workflow management for proposal, presales, and sales engineering teams.


### Ombud best features


- **OmMatch** automatically suggests answers from a centralized, continuously updated content repository.
- **Built-in collaboration** with task assignments, version history, content approvals, and team workspaces.
- **Supports multiple response types** , including RFPs, security questionnaires, proposals, and statements of work (SOWs).
- **Flexible publishing options** with exports to Word, Excel, PDF, branded templates, and web portals.


### Ombud limitations


- Some workflow actions, such as assignments and uploads, can feel less intuitive according to user reviews.
- Native multilingual support is limited, with some users requesting built-in translation capabilities.


### Ombud pricing


- Ombud does not publish pricing publicly.
- They offer quote-based pricing based on team size, deployment, and required features.

## 5. QorusDocs (Best for Microsoft 365-based proposal management)


[QorusDocs](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/qorusdocs-pricing-features-reviews) is an AI-powered proposal management platform built for professional services, legal, IT, and business development teams. It helps users create proposals, RFP responses, pitches, and business cases directly within Microsoft 365, combining AI-assisted drafting with content management and collaboration tools.


### QorusDocs best features


- Native Microsoft 365 integration with Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Outlook, and Teams for[proposal creation](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/ai-generative-proposal-writing-strategies) and collaboration.
- AI-powered proposal and RFP drafting using approved content, templates, and reusable assets.
- Built-in content management with branded templates, case studies, bios, and SharePoint-backed knowledge libraries.
- Responsive customer support and customizable workflows for proposal and business development teams.


### QorusDocs limitations


- Suited for organizations already using Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.
- Some users report slow performance when working with large documents or complex projects.
- Advanced configuration and workflow setup may require technical or IT support.


### QorusDocs pricing


- QorusDocs offers quote-based pricing and does not publish rates on its website.
- Pricing varies based on the selected package (ValueHub, ProposalHub, or PitchHub), team size, and deployment requirements.

## 6. RocketDocs (Best for regulated industries and Microsoft Office users)


[RocketDocs](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/rocketdocs-pricing-features-reviews) is an enterprise response management platform that helps teams respond to RFPs, RFIs, DDQs, and security questionnaires. It combines AI-assisted drafting, content governance, and workflow automation with a strong focus on security, compliance, and Microsoft Office-based collaboration.


### RocketDocs best features


- Private AI powered by a self-hosted Llama model that generates responses without sending data to public AI providers.
- Microsoft Word and Excel integration for drafting, reviewing, and completing questionnaires without leaving Office.
- Centralized content library with AI-assisted answer matching, reusable approved content, and RapidDocs proposal automation.
- Built-in approval workflows, audit trails, and enterprise security with SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications.


### RocketDocs limitations


- Search and filtering can be difficult when working with large content libraries, according to some users.
- Advanced features and customization come with a learning curve for new users.
- Some users report limitations with document formatting, exports, and manual content management workflows.


### RocketDocs pricing


- RocketDocs offers quote-based pricing based on your team's size and requirements and does not list its pricing publicly.

## 7. Qvidian (Best for enterprise proposal and content management)


[Qvidian](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/qvidian-pricing-features-reviews) , part of Upland Software, is an enterprise proposal management platform that helps teams create proposals, RFP responses, RFIs, RFQs, DDQs, security questionnaires, and statements of work. It combines AI-assisted drafting, workflow automation, and content management to support complex proposal processes.


### Qvidian best features


- AI Assist generates, revises, and personalizes proposal content within existing workflows.
- Centralized content library with version control, content expiration, and reusable approved responses.
- Automated workflows with task assignments, approvals, document parsing, and collaboration tools.
- Native integrations with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and other enterprise applications.


### Qvidian limitations


- Search results can be inconsistent, making it harder to find the most relevant content quickly.
- Premium pricing may not suit teams that only use a small subset of the platform's features.
- AI capabilities may require additional review and refinement for complex or highly specific responses.
- Does not offer built-in AI-powered conflict detection for identifying outdated, duplicate, or conflicting content.


### Qvidian pricing


- Qvidian offers quote-based pricing tailored to your organization's size and requirements and does not list its pricing publicly.
- But, most organizations pay between $15,000 - $25,000/ year for the base license (based on third party review data).

## 8. AutoRFP.ai (Best for teams that prefer project-based pricing over per-seat pricing)


[AutoRFP.ai](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/autorfp-ai-pricing-features-reviews) is an AI-native RFP response platform built for sales, presales, and bid teams. It helps organizations respond to RFPs, DDQs, RFIs, and security questionnaires using AI-generated drafts, source-backed answers, and real-time collaboration.


### AutoRFP.ai AI best features


- AI-generated responses with source citations and confidence scores for easier verification.
- Project Agent automates tasks like executive summaries, response edits, and web research.
- Supports Word, Excel, PDF, and translates responses into 44+ languages.
- Unlimited users on all plans, with integrations for SharePoint, Confluence, Salesforce, Slack, Teams, Google Drive, and more.


### AutoRFP.ai limitations


- Pricing is based on annual project volume, which may not suit teams with unpredictable workloads.
- The user interface can feel less intuitive, and some workflows may require additional effort to navigate.
- Does not include built-in AI-powered conflict detection for identifying outdated, duplicate, or conflicting content.
- AI content governance capabilities for maintaining knowledge quality across sources are more limited compared to AI-native platforms.


### AutoRFP.ai pricing


- **Scale:** $899/month (billed annually) for **24 projects/year** , with unlimited users, AI, integrations, and support.
- **Accelerate:** $1,299/month (billed annually) for **50 projects/year** . Enterprise pricing is available for higher project volumes.

## How to choose the right Loopio alternative?


The right RFP platform depends on your team size, workflow complexity, and the level of automation you need. Before choosing a solution, consider:


Consideration What to look for


AI capabilities Look beyond AI-generated drafts. Check whether the platform can understand context, connect knowledge sources, and improve response quality over time.


Response quality controls Look for features such as content governance, conflict detection, and mechanisms to keep responses accurate and up to date.


Knowledge management Evaluate how easily the platform integrates with your existing tools and how well it centralizes proposal content.


Workflow fit Consider review workflows, approvals, collaboration, and how well the platform fits your current proposal process.


Document support Check whether it can handle the formats your team works with, including Excel questionnaires, Word documents, PDFs, and narrative proposals.


Scalability and pricing Compare pricing models, user limits, and the platform's ability to support your team's future growth.

## **FAQs**


### 1. What is the best Loopio alternative in 2026?


It depends on your needs. Inventive AI is suited for AI-first RFP automation, Responsive for enterprise teams, and Arphie for security questionnaires.


### 2. What is the difference between Loopio and AI-native RFP software?


Loopio relies heavily on content libraries, while AI-native platforms like Inventive AI use connected knowledge sources and AI agents to generate more context-aware responses.


### 3. Can I migrate my Loopio content to another RFP platform?


Yes. Most platforms support migrating existing content libraries, templates, and proposal assets, but migration support varies by vendor.


### 4. What features should I compare when choosing a Loopio alternative?


Compare AI capabilities, response quality, knowledge management, integrations, document support, workflows, security, and pricing.


### 5. Does AI replace proposal teams?


No. AI reduces manual work, but human review remains important for accuracy, compliance, and customer-specific responses.
